title: Engram's final-diff audit text takes up three findings from TermAl's review of the same rule
outcome: Engram's final-diff audit text takes up three findings from TermAl's review of the same rule
acceptance: Condition (c) of the authority-text rule in AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md names the audit without the words 'the coordinator's', which stand beside two named coordinators, and is met only by an audit recorded as passed

The audit paragraph of .claude/commands/review-changes.md requires, besides the reading, the comparison of each changed passage with its recorded sentence as an exact string after whitespace normalisation and a word-level diff, says what a passage without a recorded concurrence requires when the audit finds it after the freeze, and binds the audit to the input fingerprint the gate's run recorded

The change shortens or replaces text where it can and restates no rule that another passage defines; both coordinators' concurrence on the exact wording, Greg's notice and the final-diff audit are recorded on this item before the landing; the link check and the AGENTS/CLAUDE identity check pass and the review pair is clean on the frozen tree
The paragraph says who sends the frozen diff to the auditing coordinator and that the change does not land before the audit is recorded

completion.summary: Engram's final-diff audit text took up the findings from TermAl's nine review rounds of the same rule: the audit is bound to the input fingerprint the checks recorded, the changed-passage unit is defined (word-level diff against the base commit, whitespace-only excluded, untracked authority files counted as added), the comparison is script-assisted exact-string matching beside the line-by-line read, removals need a concurrence naming them, the after-the-freeze remedy is stated, other files stay with the gate and the pair, and condition (c) requires the audit recorded as passed — with the defective whole-file parenthesis replaced by a reference to the Authority and Git conditions. Landed as f42ccca on master after both coordinators' concurrence, Greg's notice, the pair clean of Medium-or-higher, and Termal::Fable2's script-assisted audit recorded as passed. All four acceptance criteria passed on evaluation 94def613 (independent_session Claude). The one source-change obligation is docs-only and recorded as untested by done.
